steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Combine. Deal terms are placed into the approved template, and each variation is listed.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 deal term has no place in the template

findings.title: Deal term with no place in the template
findings.fix: Add the term to the template or as a variation

findings.title: Variation with no reason stated
findings.fix: State the reason for the variation

findings.title: Template clause left unchanged that the deal contradicts
findings.fix: Change the clause to match the deal

outcome.notChecked: Whether the draft is enforceable; the law of the jurisdiction.
